name: button
title: Button
description: Every action in the console: secondary by default; dark for the one main action, the website's pixel button with red squares running in on hover; ghost for tools in rows; danger for what removes something, held to confirm; brand for the fix to a failure; and a square icon button.
use_for: Any action in place: create, copy, save, revoke, open a menu. One dark button per view; the rest secondary or ghost. 28px tall with 12px labels, 40px on phones.
never: Two dark buttons on one view
A faded button for "not yet": disabled is grey with a dark label
Red text on a secondary button instead of the danger variant

examples.name: Ghost
examples.label: Ghost
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue'
import { RefreshCw } from 'lucide-vue-next'
import Button from '@/components/ui/Button.vue'
// A tool in a row, as a source's Sync now: its icon turns while it syncs, and it waits until the sync lands.
const syncing = ref(false)
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
function sync() {
  syncing.value = true
  // ds-latency: stands in for the sync request in this example.
  timer = setTimeout(() => { syncing.value = false }, 1800)
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer))
</script>

<template>
  <Button variant="ghost" press :disabled="syncing" @click="sync">
    <RefreshCw :size="12" :stroke-width="1.5" :class="{ 'animate-spin motion-reduce:animate-none': syncing }" aria-hidden="true" />{{ syncing ? 'Syncing' : 'Sync now' }}
  </Button>
</template>

attributes.description: The name for assistive tech, passed to the inner button (aria-label on the element).

attributes.name: aria-description
attributes.description: A description for assistive tech (a tooltip's text), passed to the inner button (aria-description on the element).
